description: Test fixture for issue #337 round three: an operator-authored dataset whose interaction severity carries surrounding whitespace. DrugSafetyValidator.severityRank trims before recognising a rating, so the module treats this rule as Major everywhere — the floor admits it, the strength clause withholds on it, the chips order by it. Nothing else trims, because DrugReference.Interaction.severity is bound straight from the JSON. So the rating a consumer is handed must be the form the module RECOGNISED, not the raw field, or a comparison against answer prose is made against a padded needle.

interactions.note: Major. Coadministration may increase the risk of bleeding.
